title: Identity And Library Access Contract
problem: Nako needs durable local users, roles, Library Access, and principal resolution before Media Web, multi-user playback, or permission-gated admin context links can ship.

evidence.summary: Opened identity/access execution lane with baseline migration consolidation allowed while Nako has no production users.

Defined identity/access domain records and repository skeletons; generated SQLite/PostgreSQL baseline migration files; rewired backend migrators to one baseline migration each; removed old numbered migration files; focused core/db gates passed.

Implemented SQLite/PostgreSQL identity/access repository adapters and contract coverage; startup now creates the deterministic bootstrap administrator user for local-admin; inbound auth resolves the configured bearer token to stable principal data without storing token material.

Added redaction-safe Admin API access-management DTOs, routes, validation, generated Admin Web contract types, and system coverage for local users, roles, status changes, and Library Access policy rows.

continue_policy.notes: Continue with ILA-040. Admin API access-management contracts exist, but Public Client API browse/playback/user-state flows still need effective Library Access enforcement. If production compatibility appears, stop and switch to forward-only migrations.
